name: ROBUST Designer
description: Master mRNA-design campaign: sha256 accession gate; six-target x five-seed GRPO-style design loop over a shared evaluator ensemble (codon usage, ViennaRNA structure, innate-immune motifs, miRNA seeds); equal-budget random baseline, codon_optimizer and LinearDesign baselines, and five weight-ablation reruns with paired Wilcoxon statistics; a learned degradation evaluator trained on the PERSIST construct panel with leakage audit and OpenVaccine external ranking; an augmented design rerun folding the learned member into the ensemble; and a GPU direct-RNA m6A validation arm (SG-Nex POD5 -> Dorado m6A_DRACH -> modkit -> GLORI per-site metrics). campaign_results_builder exports the whole run tree.

params.text: HALTED: accession verification failed. The gate wrote per-row failures to its manifest_status.json (missing file, sha256 mismatch, or bad fetch_date). Nothing downstream of the branch runs; fix the staged data or the manifest, then rerun.

params.targets:
egfp	data/egfp_u55762.fasta
insulin	data/insulin_nm000207.fasta
il12b	data/il12b_nm002187.fasta

wt1	data/wt1_nm000378.fasta

params.text:
MASTER CAMPAIGN WORKFLOW (single-file paper deliverable).

Phase map: 0 Accession Gate -> 1 Campaign Config -> 2 E1 design campaign (GRPO-style) -> 3 E2 baselines + ablations + paired stats -> 4 E3 learned evaluator (constructs + OpenVaccine) -> E1-augmented rerun with the learned ensemble member -> 5 E4 direct-RNA m6A validation (GPU, parallel gate branch) -> 6 Export (campaign_results_builder scans the whole run tree).

Every phase is a subgraph node whose embedded workflow is inspectable on disk. The design loop reward is the ENSEMBLE evaluator (codon usage CAI/GC-window-deviation, ViennaRNA MFE, innate-immune motif burden, miRNA seed hits, and - in the augmented rerun only - the E3-learned degradation predictor). The old hardcoded demo prior on scores_1 is GONE: scores_1 is now the live codon-metrics ensemble port.

Data rides between loop levels as JSON-lines row strings (campaign_config_builder pairs.jsonl / targets.jsonl / ablations.jsonl); in-loop field access uses string_format extractors, so no weights, seeds, or CDS constants are copy-pasted inside any subgraph. Weights arrive at the scorer via ports (port-keyed weights_json per row); the learned-model path arrives via cfg_aug.annotate_value.

Cloud phase note: E2 = 30 pairs x 30 iterations x 48 candidates x evaluator; ablations add 5 x 6 pairs x 30 iterations. RNAfold on the order of 10^5 short transcripts is minutes-scale with ViennaRNA on PATH (the structure arm degrades fail-soft where ViennaRNA is absent, e.g. CI).

Config provenance.

Targets (six, repo-relative FASTAs under data/): EGFP U55762.1, insulin NM_000207, IL12B NM_002187, firefly luciferase M15077.1, SARS-CoV-2 RBA fragment NC_045512.2 nt 22517-23185, WT1 NM_000378. Seeds: 13, 101, 2024, 4242, 9001 (paired across methods). iterations=30, batch=48, top_k=8: these numbers are set once on the loop nodes (single-set node params) and echoed by campaign_config_builder into campaign_config.json for the record/export.

Accession manifest: templates/data/verified_inputs_manifest.tsv pins sha256 of every repo-staged input the workflow reads (targets, constructs, samples, GLORI, OpenVaccine, Kazusa codon table). The full provenance manifest with external URLs/s3 keys lives at templates/data/accession_manifest.tsv. The gate resolves relative 'file' entries against base_dir, then the manifest directory, then cwd - so staged workspaces pass with base_dir=<workspace root> and repo checkouts pass with cwd=repo root.

Kazusa equivalence: codon_metrics CAI uses the bundled human codon-usage table (data/hsapiens_codon_usage.tsv, Kazusa CTG-OSD Homo sapiens [9606]); campaign weights are unit weights by default - {cai:1, structure:1, gc:1, immune:1, mirna:1} - mapped onto scorer ports scores_1..scores_5 by campaign_config_builder.objective_ports; the learned member rides scores_6 in the augmented rerun.

A-priori success bars (declared before any run of this master):

  - m6A validation (E4): recall >= 0.80 at the 10% FDR calling point AND AUROC >= 0.75 against GLORI 293T rep1 per-site truth (metagene profile must show the canonical DRACH enrichment near stop codons).
  - Learned evaluator (E3): 5-fold CV Spearman >= 0.70 against degradation_coef_in_cell on the labelled construct panel (203 rows); OpenVaccine external-arm Spearman >= 0 (report exact value; the arm measures ranking transfer, not absolute degradation).
  - Design loop (E1/E2): paired Wilcoxon across the 30 target x seed pairs, ours vs equal-budget random search, on CAI (>=), immune burden per kb (<=), weighted miRNA hits (<=), and MFE (<=; ViennaRNA-dependent); significance alpha=0.05, two-sided, exact Wilcoxon n<=20.
  - Leakage: 0 exact duplicates and max 31-mer containment < 0.5 between E1 best designs and the E3 training constructs.

Benchmark anchors: Zou et al. 2025 (Nat Methods, doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02623-4) m6A call benchmark; GLORI Liu et al. 2022 (Science) qPCR-orthogonal per-site truth; OpenVaccine/Wayment-Steele 2023 RYOS degradation arrays; GRPO arXiv:2402.03300 and MO-GRPO antecedent arXiv:2605.01513.

Seed table (all deterministic; every RNG is seeded).

  - Campaign pair seeds 13/101/2024/4242/9001: ride pairs.jsonl rows; inside a design loop the sampler seed is pair_seed x round (counter_accumulator add), so every (pair, iteration) batch is reproducible.
  - Ablations use seed 13 only (single-seed screening; 5 weight variants x 6 targets x 30 iters).
  - E1-augmented rerun: seeds {13, 2024} on {egfp, luc} (4 pairs) with the learned member live.
  - E3 ridge train/CV: seed 13; POD5 subsample: seed 13, 1,000,000 reads.
  - Subgraph seeds derive deterministically from the run master seed via the executor's subgraph seed derivation (sha256(master:subgraph_id) masked to 31 bits).

WT1 length flag: NM_000378 (WT1 isoform 1) is ~1.5 kb CDS - 3x longer than the other targets, so WT1 pairs dominate per-iteration wall time (batch RNAfold and policy updates scale with CDS length). Reported per-target stats therefore quote pair counts, not compute; drop WT1 from cfg.targets for a cheaper smoke campaign.

LinearDesign license: LinearDesign (Zhang et al. 2023, Nat Comput Sci) is Microsoft Research code released under the MS-RSL license (research, non-commercial); the lineardesign_optimize node clones the pinned upstream commit on Linux workers only. B3 is therefore Linux-only, per-target (6 runs), continue-on-fail, and excluded from paired stats (single deterministic design per target gives no seed replicates); its scores are reported descriptively in per_subgraph.tsv.

PERSIST label column: degradation_coef_in_cell (GSE173083 barnalab/persist; Ma et al., PERSIST mRNA stability panel). 203 of 233 constructs carry a non-null label; rows with an empty label or empty CDS.sequence are dropped before training (filter_rows). RNA.sequence/X5UTR.sequence are U-RNA; CDS.sequence is DNA - the evaluator maps U->T internally where needed.

POD5 subsample justification: the full SG-Nex Hek293T directRNA rep5 run is 435 GiB (>20 GB download quoted in the provenance manifest as NOT_DOWNLOADED). The open-data bucket is accessed anonymously (s3_download anonymous=true -> aws s3 cp --no-sign-request). pod5_subset keeps a seed-13 deterministic 1,000,000-read subset (~2-3 GiB), which at >=20x coverage over expressed transcripts is sufficient for per-site m6A validation at min_coverage=20.

GPU justification: dorado_basecaller with the RNA004 130bps hac v5.1.0 simplex model plus the m6A_DRACH modified-base model requires a CUDA device (device=auto). GRCh38 alignment happens inside dorado (reference wired to the faidx'd primary assembly), so the modBAM is genome-aligned for modkit extract and GLORI coordinate joining. The whole E4 group is a parallel gate branch: E1-E3 never wait on the GPU.

Export: campaign_results_builder runs with run_dir EMPTY, which resolves to the executor's runs/<run_id> root, so one pass scans every phase subgraph's iteration artifacts (long-format CSV, summary.json, per_subgraph.tsv with per-loop best composite + raw per-objective scores + best CDS for leakage audits). The 'after' input is the completion barrier: it fans in e1/e2/e3/e1_aug/e4 subgraph_dir values so the scan never races a phase.
